LanguageData.CC_Settings_PlaceNames: The colony's names for its places
LanguageData.CC_Settings_PlaceNames_Tip: Places on the home map get names from what first happened there, given by one of the colony's people who was there: where a god was seen, the colony's first graves out in the open, a tree beside a gathering, a gate where a raid was held, where a flood reached the path or the fields. Whoever names a place says it aloud, and the chronicle keeps it. The names come up at supper, in the colony's letters and on a god's card. A place whose tree, gate or graves are gone loses its name after a season.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_PlaceNames: Places at home get names from what happened there.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_PlaceLabels: Names of places on the map
LanguageData.CC_Settings_PlaceLabels_Tip: The colony's names for its places as quiet labels on the map, drawn the way the game draws its own labels, when the view is close enough. A place that is gone fades out over a season.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_PlaceLabels: The names of places show on the map.
